candidates.label: HZ

Zero size/timing change on either side.

threatFindings.threat: zchain4 and rev0 warriors are lattice-compatible (FAR_SEG 0FFBh, all phases 10h/2Ch/70h and steps 2C00h/3C00h/4400h keep anchors at in-page 52h mod 400h)
threatFindings.evidence: Static: phase*100h and step are multiples of 400h, band 3C00h*k = 0 mod 400h. Compatibility did not give points (sdsgd, 74i3u, 2boer all negative).
threatFindings.impact: Geometry is not the obstacle; the hybrids still lose.

threatFindings.threat: zombie-cell interplay: zchain4 A's EB F9 CC CC decoy at FFECh would take rev0 B's backward EB F9 CC CC b/d search (A runs first), and rev0 A's zom20a capture / zchain4 B's capture route to cells ([4A17h] vs [0CC13h]) the partner does not serve
threatFindings.evidence: Static reading of the sources only; HZ was built to avoid it (B search 0F EB F9 CC -> jmp [0CC13h]), so the naive pairing was not screened.
threatFindings.impact: A naive warrior swap would lose the b/d and/or zom20a capture (~0.1-0.2/battle per B052).

threatFindings.threat: same band phase (zchain4 A 10h, rev0 B 10h) gives identical first anchors when both load in the same 3Ch band (~1/4 of battles)
threatFindings.evidence: Static; avoided in HZ by phase 2Ch, not measured.

threatFindings.threat: zchain4's plain-2025 advantage can be inherited by swapping in one zchain4 warrior (whole warrior or its replicator parameters)
threatFindings.evidence: Pure zchain4 2025 +0.065 lo>0 (e2glt), but HZ 2025 -0.045 (sdsgd), HAb -0.036 (74i3u), HBb -0.030 (2boer): all three hybrids are below BOTH parents on the 2025 group.
threatFindings.impact: zchain4's 2025 edge is a pair property (A/B phase and step relation, both decoys at FFE8h/FFECh, early dual capture), not a property of one warrior.

threatFindings.threat: rev0's robustness vs strong/leaders depends on its replicator parameters in both warriors
threatFindings.evidence: HAb strong -0.115 [-0.200,-0.030] (74i3u); HBb threat -0.094 lo<0, zchain4 cohort -0.433 (2boer); HAb/HBb multi -0.069/-0.104 (both lo<0).
threatFindings.impact: Do not swap either warrior's step/gap/phase to zchain4 values.

threatFindings.threat: zchain4 is weak vs leaders/strong field on screen S
threatFindings.evidence: e2glt strong -0.154 0/6, threat -0.070, multi -0.113, matches confirm-arm results in FINDINGS.

recommendation: Do not promote any A046 candidate. All three hybrids screen clearly negative (HZ -0.043, HAb -0.045, HBb -0.061, each interval below 0) and each loses on the plain 2025 group, where the pure zchain4 control gains +0.065. A one-warrior swap keeps neither parent's strength. Close this card. If zchain4's 2025 edge is pursued again, test its pair-level features on the rev0 base one at a time (for example the second EB F9 decoy at [0FFE8h] that B's own 0F EB F9 CC search skips), not its warriors or parameters.
notes: Base revision 0 throughout. Sources built by scratch/A046/mk.cjs (exact line edits of refs/zchain4 and revisions/rev0). Untested confound: HZ uses phase 2Ch instead of zchain4 A's 10h.
